name: Fate Foreseen / hand-opt-one-top-then-draw
notes: Fate Foreseen costs0 and defends for printed 3 from either hand or arsenal; no source-zone bonus. Opt1 looks only at original top wounding_blow_red; choose top, leaving order ['wounding_blow_red', 'wounding_blow_yellow']. Subsequent Sink Below blue bottoms the independent hand filler raging_onslaught_blue and draws wounding_blow_red; this persisted hand-card assertion proves the chosen ordering rather than only deck membership.
